purpose: Test three genuinely new lexical/rule predicates: same-gana marker contrasts, weak-perfect e/loss alternation, and specialized nonpresent it. No outcome-based item selection.
suggested_sampling: Evaluate all178frozenquestions:60marker,60weakperfect,58specialit. Report all-request/completed metrics,mechanism/subtype/family diagnostics and every oracle disagreement.

estimate.calculation: Conservative1500inputtokens/task. Coordinator must recompute under cumulative budget lock.

paired_astra_recommendation.condition: Pair only if Opus shows source-supported error signal across multiple fresh families and oracle audit passes.

submission_status: Ready for coordinator review; no worker paid calls.

predeclared_analysis.primary: Exact match against the full audited accepted form set, completed-answer accuracy and all-request accuracy reported separately.
predeclared_analysis.subgroups: Report three main cells and fixed15accent/45othermarker,30positive/30prohibition perfect subsets. Display all results, including easy groups.
predeclared_analysis.promising_signal: A main cell with at least8source-supported grammatical errors spanning at least6families warrants a fresh confirmatory panel. The smaller30question perfect subgroup needs at least5errors across4families to motivate, not certify, follow-up. These are pragmatic discovery triggers, not significance tests or release acceptance.
predeclared_analysis.negative_result: If no cell shows this signal, do not assume80percent is impossible: report the tested mechanisms as disconfirmed at useful scale and list any independently justified untested hypotheses. Do not repeat model-missed items or use refusals to create hardness.
predeclared_analysis.release: No final task membership or weights fixed by this pilot. Final sets require independent families, predeclared diversity and family-aware uncertainty, plus bothreference scores if funded.
